scenes.title: Epoxy floor *slippery* hota hai?
scenes.body: Myth vs fact: swipe karo, sach jaano.

scenes.title: Har epoxy *phisalta* nahi
scenes.body: Smooth glossy finish geela hone par phisal sakta hai. Par anti-slip system se grip milti hai. Sahi finish chuna zaroori hai.

scenes.title: Safai se *grip* bani rahe
scenes.body: Routine mopping karein aur tel ya spill turant saaf karein. Kam ghisne wale cleaners chunein.
